Package uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.render.flexmark

package uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.render.flexmark
Provides Flexmark markdown extensions tailored for Swing HTML rendering.

This package implements AST post-processors, custom nodes, and HTML renderers that translate LaTeX mathematical symbols, logical operators, and directional arrows into standard Unicode glyphs compatible with Swing's HTMLEditorKit without requiring client-side JavaScript libraries (e.g. KaTeX or MathJax).
